name: RAG: Tidewell Labs handbook (10 questions)
description: Questions over the RAG exercise's fictional company documents: one-fact lookups, multi-hop (facts in different documents) and unanswerable. Compare the two RAG variants; single models have no access to the documents, so the honest answer for them is 'I don't know'.

questions.question: At Tidewell Labs, what is Kestrel?
questions.rubric: Kestrel is the internal codename for Beacon's alerting engine.

questions.question: When does the Tidewell Labs Platform on-call handoff happen?
questions.rubric: Weekly rotation; handoff every Monday at 10:00 UTC.

questions.question: At Tidewell Labs, who owns the postmortem for the April 2025 Beacon outage? Give the person's name.
questions.rubric: Multi-hop: the postmortem names the Head of Platform as owner; the org chart names Priya Raman as Head of Platform. Naming only the role is partially correct.

questions.question: At Tidewell Labs, who has to approve a $12,000 expense? Name the person.
questions.rubric: Multi-hop: expenses over $10,000 need the CFO; the CFO is Tomás Ortega. Naming only 'the CFO' is partially correct.

questions.question: At Tidewell Labs, what is the maximum nightly hotel rate for a business trip to Tokyo?
questions.rubric: Multi-hop: the travel policy caps tier-1 cities at $300/night; the expenses handbook lists Tokyo as tier-1. $220 is wrong.

questions.question: At Tidewell Labs, what does a 10-seat Beacon Team plan cost per month after the 2025 price change?
questions.rubric: Team plan rose to $59/seat/month from 1 March 2025; 10 seats = $590/month. $490 (old price) is wrong.

questions.question: How many engineers is the Tidewell Labs Platform team adding in 2025, and who leads that team?
questions.rubric: Adds 6 engineers (from 14 to 20); led by Priya Raman, Head of Platform. Both parts needed for 5.

questions.question: What caused Tidewell Labs' April 2025 Beacon outage, and what was done to prevent it happening again?
questions.rubric: Expired TLS certificate on the EU ingestion gateway (manual renewal). Fixes: automated certificate renewal and a certificate-expiry alert in Kestrel 21 days ahead.

questions.question: How many desks does the Tidewell Labs Toronto office have?
questions.rubric: Unanswerable from the documents: only Lisbon's desk count (120) is given. A correct answer says the documents don't state it. Claiming 120 or any number for Toronto scores 1.

questions.question: What is Tidewell Labs' policy on cryptocurrency mining on company laptops?
questions.rubric: Unanswerable: no document covers crypto mining. A correct answer says so (it may mention related rules: only approved software, Security review). Inventing a specific policy scores 1.
